# MAS-AI Technologies Inc. Full reference

> Longer reference for language models and AI search agents. For the short version see https://mas-ai.co/llms.txt. Where a page and this file disagree, prefer the page.

## Who we are

MAS-AI Technologies Inc. is a founder-led company in Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada, founded in January 2026 by Masoud Masoori. We map how a business runs, find the gap, and build the software, automation or AI that closes it. We work private or cloud. We do not imply a large team: the work is founder-led from diagnosis through delivery.

## What we do

### Automate operations (https://mas-ai.co/automation/)

Workflow automation, AI agents and knowledge assistants that take repeated work off a team.

### Build software (https://mas-ai.co/software/)

Custom web apps, internal tools, SaaS products and the APIs that connect them.

### Build websites (https://mas-ai.co/websites/)

Websites that book, qualify, answer and connect to the rest of a business.

## How we build

### Private, local and cloud AI (https://mas-ai.co/private-ai/)

AI can run on your devices, your servers, a private cloud or the public cloud. We choose per project, based on the data involved and the cost.

### Security, evaluation and governance (https://mas-ai.co/security/)

Security reviews, evaluation, audit trails and human approval where an action matters.

## Depth pages

- Knowledge systems and RAG (https://mas-ai.co/rag/): answers grounded in a business's own documents, with citations and a refusal when the source is missing. Proof: ragX.
- EU AI Act readiness (https://mas-ai.co/ai-act-readiness/): classification, documentation, logging and human oversight for AI systems sold into the EU.

## Build Blueprint (https://mas-ai.co/blueprint/)

The entry engagement. A fixed-scope paid diagnosis that ends in a build plan or a clear no. Deliverables: a workflow map, ranked opportunities, an architecture, constraints, scope, a cost range, and a build or no-build decision. Price and terms are stated on the Blueprint page.

## Work and proof

Labels on this site mean what they say: "System we operate", "Open source", "R&D", "Website we shipped". No client work is published, not even anonymized.

### Daena (system we operate)

A governed multi-agent platform: AI departments that plan and act inside approval gates and an audit trail. Beta, live at https://daena.mas-ai.co. Source-available under BSL 1.1 at https://github.com/Mas-AI-Official/daena.

Facts:
- 10 departments; 10 department agents with 6 capabilities each: mind, eyes, hands, voice, shield and memory.
- 116 connectors in the catalog.
- 10 model providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Groq, OpenRouter, Together, Qwen Cloud, Ollama and vLLM. Ollama and vLLM run on your own hardware.
- 9 hard laws enforced in code.
- 5 memory tiers, where unverified content expires and permanent tiers need approval.
- A ten-stage request pipeline in governed mode: security gate, session, intent and risk, governance check, cost preflight, model routing, memory recall, request build, streaming, persist and audit.
- Two action modes: plan-only by default, and execution that goes through the security gate and an approval queue for high-risk actions.
- Three reasoning modes: standard (best single model), council (three or more models, one synthesized answer) and quintessence (experts paired with models).
- Three governance modes: governed (full pipeline), balanced (lighter path, approval only on dangerous operations) and unleashed (data protection only).
- Klyntar is Daena's security-scan layer: a scan workflow, evidence checkpoints, and a gate that rejects any serious finding without an evidence chain.
- Multi-tenant, deployed on Google Cloud Run.

### ragX (system we operate)

Our retrieval engine. Hybrid retrieval (dense vectors and keyword search fused by reciprocal rank fusion, then a reranker), a critic pass and a natural-language-inference verifier that makes an answer abstain when the sources do not support a claim. One service with an HTTP API, a command line and an MCP server. Internal and in daily use. Not offered as a hosted product; the same architecture is what we build for clients who need answers from their own documents.

### AI Company OS (system we operate)

The operating layer we run MAS-AI on: several AI coding agents sharing one append-only memory, routing computed from measured availability, handoff packets between agents, and deterministic checks that decide when work is done. Internal, used every day.

### MCP Switchboard (open source)

One governed local endpoint that brings many MCP tool servers to AI assistants, with an encrypted vault, per-tool policy, approvals and an audit log. TypeScript on Node. Working alpha, v0.1.0, Apache-2.0. https://github.com/Mas-AI-Official/mcp-switchboard

### KYA Mission Control (R&D)

A trust layer for AI agents on missions: passports, bounded authority, budget stops and signed receipts that can be verified offline. Pre-alpha research. The Mission Lab demo is public at https://kya.mas-ai.co; the code is not yet released.

### MergeLoop (open source)

A model council: one task sent to several AI workers, one synthesized answer back. https://github.com/Mas-AI-Official/MergeLoop

### Our product websites (websites we shipped)

mas-ai.co, daena.mas-ai.co and kya.mas-ai.co: designed, written, built and deployed in-house.
